posen.titel: More pictures of Aylin and Ozan
absaetze: On the background pages about coffee cup reading, tarot and readings, more pictures show Aylin writing and holding a gift, and Aylin and Ozan with tarot cards; on the pages about dreams, Aylin and Ozan appear under the moon. The pictures with tarot cards were made with Canva’s image generator, the others with the Seedream 5.5 image generator at ElevenLabs. All of them were edited for Tarot Cup; for this website they were only scaled down and saved as AVIF and WebP.
